positions.title: Graduate Assistant (Disability Services)
positions.description:
Created accessible educational material and alternatives to written text for students.

Aided students of the UNCC's Disability Services department with their classwork for the Human Computer Interaction course. The course focused on User Experience and User Interface design so primarily worked with the student to create wireframes, prototypes and design evaluations.

company.name: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

positions.title: Web Applications - Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed an internal web-based tool for handling chargebacks for infrastructure usage costs from internal shared services and external vendors, using Vue.js, Node.js, and MS SQL. 

Improved the existing process increasing overall efficiency and usability by implementing a learnable design based on UX principles. 

Developed a proof of concept project for handling cloud account request process utilizing the Workfront API.

positions.title: Industrial Project
positions.description:
Collaborated with team members to develop an IOT Smart Mirror prototype for undergrad final year project, that utilizes Raspberry Pii to integrate with the reflective mirror displaying a web application developed in NodeJS. 

Integrated features/widgets such as Clock, Weather, News Excerpts, Email, Instagram and a web based mobile application to update settings and manage social media accounts displayed on the mirror.
